## Projects
- [IntelliML Platform](https://anilpaneru.com.np/projects/1-intelliml-platform): AI-powered data science platform that automates EDA, data cleaning, and model training via natural language interface.
- [SafeVision](https://anilpaneru.com.np/projects/2-safevision): Real-time deep learning pipeline achieving 97% accuracy in detecting violent activities in video streams with automated alerts.
- [Intrusion Detection System](https://anilpaneru.com.np/projects/3-intrusion-detection-system): AI-powered intrusion detection system built with XGBoost, FastAPI, React, Scapy, and Telegram alerts.
